b1.method: device: traced replay device-kernel sums (device 0, last 4 replays) from 2-layer profiles (0,3) and (0,1,3); 40-layer = terminal + sampler + 30 GDN + 10 full. e2e: run_batch_perf median of 3. roofline: runs/main/stage07/roofline.py (weights at stored dtypes, GDN FP32 state read+write, KV at 192 tokens, 512 GB/s per chip).

b32.method: device: traced replay device-kernel sums (device 0, last 4 replays) from 2-layer profiles (0,3) and (0,1,3); 40-layer = terminal + sampler + 30 GDN + 10 full. e2e: run_batch_perf median of 3. roofline: runs/main/stage07/roofline.py (weights at stored dtypes, GDN FP32 state read+write, KV at 192 tokens, 512 GB/s per chip).

named_limitations: Decode is device-bound: device time equals end-to-end within 1.3%; no host gap remains.
B1 reaches 16% of the DRAM roofline: about 480 small ops per step (per-op latency bound, 40 layers x 12 to 24 ops).
B32 MoE slot path reads each selected expert once per row slot (256 slot reads vs about 163 unique experts) because expert de-duplication needs a device-side unique op.
B32 GDN layer 1530 us vs 195 us at B1: batched GDN kernels plus row-tiled tilize/untilize; GDN state traffic alone is about 64 us per layer.
Sampler top-k on the 62080-wide local vocabulary: 285 us per step (TopkLargeIndices).
